tty.description: The virtual console device to manage (e.g., tty1, tty2).

noclear.description: Do not clear the screen before prompting for the login name.

nonewline.description: Do not print a newline before writing out /etc/issue.

nohangup.description: Do not call vhangup() to disable writing to this tty by other applications.

nohostname.description: Do not print the hostname before the login prompt.

long_hostname.description: Show the full text from gethostname() instead of stopping at the first dot.

nice.description: Nice value (priority) for the mingetty process.

delay.description: Number of seconds to sleep after startup of mingetty.

chdir.description: Directory to change into before calling the login prog.

chroot.description: Directory to chroot into. Empty string disables chroot.

autologin.description: Username to log in automatically. Empty string disables autologin.

loginpause.description: Wait for any key before dropping to the login prompt.
